brief: Overthrow = bright day isles. Flagfall = night violet garden. Names stay open. Weathered stone, heft, ink line, vast quiet skies; creatures with some edge.

jobs.name: Day isles
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. New original art for a fast 3v3 hero brawler made with three.js flat colours and ink outlines. Reference images are STYLE AND PALETTE references only, not edit targets: evolve their floating islands and flora toward Oskar's requested Moebius / Warhammer blend. Vast quiet skies, confident precise dark ink contour, restrained sparse hatch on rock side planes, flat graphic colour fields, chunky primitive-buildable geometry, tangible weathered stone, chipped edges and weight. European science-fantasy comic landscape with small tough mischievous creatures rather than sugary mascots. No existing franchise characters or iconography. No chibi baby faces, smiling moons, sparkles, candy softness, generic medieval fantasy, cyberpunk, photorealism or rich painterly texture. No text, lettering, logos, watermarks, menu controls or card frames.
Asset: clean full-bleed 16:9 splash background plate, exactly 2560x1440. Frame a huge pale warm cream and dusty peach sky above a pink cloud sea. Monumental grassy floating sandstone/lavender stone pillars with old worn tiled caps, one broken simple stone arch, narrow waterfalls, a few angular olive leaves and burnt orange bell flowers. Put the closest heavy rock pillars at far left lower edge and far right lower edge, with small distant low-contrast isles along the low horizon at y~1100. A tiny weather-beaten horned leaf traveller with a square battered shoulder plate and ragged little cape stands on the FAR RIGHT lower ledge, surveying the vast drop; a small scale accent, not a focal hero. Strong mass and real height, still inviting and sunny. Composition is a production menu backing: UPPER LEFT x100–1050,y70–350 absolutely quiet pale sky for the real logo; CENTRAL x500–2060,y360–1160 very quiet open atmosphere for TWO real tall menu cards side by side. Do NOT draw either logo or cards. Reserve low centre for the bonus button. All dark silhouettes, flowers, creature and arch remain OUTSIDE the central menu area. Airy, almost austere, no busy clouds or centre island. Continuous natural scene, no hard empty rectangle. Upper two-thirds predominantly calm sky.
